g.title: J_EPS_JET
g.text: EPS board: SW1 PAYLOAD 5 V, after the JETSON_PWR soft-start gate (4 A)

g.title: W5A
g.text: 2 A per wire at the 4 A gate; 20 AWG is 3 A derated. Peak 8 W at the input

g.title: J_OBC_JET
g.text: OBC board: PA9 TX, PA10 RX via S7 buffer

g.title: W5B
g.text: 115200 baud, SQSO-ICD-004 framing; TX crosses to RXD
